title: Claude Code Hook Envelope v1
description: Documents the JSON envelope Claude Code sends on stdin to cortina when a hook fires. This is the consumer-side contract: cortina reads these fields, Claude Code is the producer. No schema_version is present because Claude Code does not include one. Producer: Claude Code runtime. Consumer: cortina/src/adapters/claude_code.rs.

hook_event_name.description: Name of the hook that fired. Known values: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, Stop, UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact, PermissionRequest, Notification, SubagentStart, MessageDisplay. No enum constraint is applied because Claude Code is the producer and may add new event types.

session_id.description: Claude Code session identifier. Present on most hooks.

cwd.description: Working directory of the agent process at the time the hook fired.

transcript_path.description: Absolute path to the session transcript JSONL file. Present on Stop and UserPromptSubmit hooks.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that was called. Present on PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks.

tool_input.description: Tool-specific input arguments. Shape varies by tool_name.

file_path.description: Target file path (Write, Edit, MultiEdit tools).

tool_output.description: Tool-specific output. Present on PostToolUse hooks.

payload_format_version.description: Documents whether the envelope came from Claude Code 2.x or the legacy shape. Legacy payloads omit this field.

content.description: Polymorphic tool response content. Either a plain string (legacy) or an array of typed response blocks (Claude Code 2.x).

oneOf.description: Structured array of typed response blocks (Claude Code 2.x shape).

text.description: Text content of the response block.

prompt.description: The user prompt text. Present on UserPromptSubmit hooks.

message_text.description: The assistant message text surfaced to the operator. Present on MessageDisplay hooks.

trigger.description: Compaction trigger reason (e.g. 'manual', 'auto'). Present on PreCompact hooks.

custom_instructions.description: Custom system instructions for the compacted session. Present on PreCompact hooks.

tool_error.description: Error message from the failed tool. Present on PostToolUseFailure hooks.

permission_decision.description: The permission decision made for the request. Known values: allow, deny, ask. No enum constraint is applied because Claude Code is the producer and may add new decision types. Present on PermissionRequest hooks.

permission_tool_name.description: Name of the tool the permission request applies to. Present on PermissionRequest hooks.

notification_title.description: Title of the notification. Present on Notification hooks.

notification_message.description: Body text of the notification. Present on Notification hooks.

subagent_id.description: Identifier for the subagent that is starting. Present on SubagentStart hooks.

subagent_task.description: Description of the task assigned to the subagent. Present on SubagentStart hooks.
